purpose: Preview-only cover composition studies; existing SVG designs preserved.

variants.title: A · 上扬斜排
variants.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished 16:9 landscape tournament cover composition study for osu! Chinese League Rookie.
Reference 1 is the CURRENT approved letter-shape base, NOT a composition to copy rigidly: angular cut-corner O, C, L and angular S11; very distinctive rounded osu slider R with six colored editor control nodes and straight connecting control polygon. Keep the R's recognizable geometry and nodes, never substitute a generic font R. Retain hollow outline lettering so the scenery shows through the interiors. Make contours sufficiently substantial and legible at cover size. The small calligraphic Chinese character "喝" must stay anchored at the UPPER RIGHT OF THE R, not over S11.
Reference 2 is Liru, the existing mascot: preserve her lavender hair, side ponytail, green sprout, red/blue hair clip, purple eyes, lavender athletic jacket, T4 badge, white shirt and gray pleated skirt. Use this same character, no additional people. Clean anime illustration with controlled details, no fuzzy glow halo.
Reference 3 is the existing violet/pink sunset riverside skyline background. Preserve its visual identity and sunset palette, simplify detail and darken selectively behind outline letters for clarity.
Text verbatim: "OCLR", "S11", "OSU! CHINESE LEAGUE ROOKIE", and small "喝". No other slogans, dates, sponsor names, invented logos, UI buttons or labels.
Hierarchy: OCLR is unequivocally the main title. S11 is a small subordinate season designation, only about 25–35% of the OCLR capital height, never comparable to the whole title size. Preserve a thin yellow-green-blue-green-yellow accuracy bar between OCLR and the small English full name; treat it as part of the title composition. A few purposeful osu cursor-trail lines may guide the eye, with plenty of clean negative space. Avoid noisy dot fields, arbitrary circuitry, excessive decoration, 3D extrusions or distressed textures. This is a raster cover concept, not a browser screenshot and not a sheet of multiple thumbnails.
COMPOSITION A — bold ascending diagonal: title OCLR fills the left 62% and rises about 14 degrees from lower-left toward upper-right, as one coherent expressive block. English subtitle and accuracy bar follow the same diagonal. Tuck SMALL S11 just below and to the right of R, clearly subordinate. Liru appears large on the right, roughly thigh-up, with her raised hand toward the upper-right, partially behind the title extremity without covering letters or her face. Sunset horizon stays level; contrast the diagonal typography against it. Strong rhythm, high energy, clean violet/ivory/pink outlines.
